+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, Optional
+
+from azure.storage.blob import BlobServiceClient
+
+
+@dataclass
+class StorageConfig:
+    account_url: str
+    credential: Optional[str] = None
+    container_name: Optional[str] = None
+
+
+def load_storage_config() -> StorageConfig:
+    return StorageConfig(
+        account_url=os.environ["AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_URL"],
+        credential=os.getenv("AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING") or os.getenv("AZURE_STORAGE_SAS_TOKEN") or os.getenv("AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_KEY"),
+        container_name=os.getenv("AZURE_STORAGE_CONTAINER_NAME"),
+    )
+
+
+def get_blob_service_client() -> BlobServiceClient:
+    cfg = load_storage_config()
+    if cfg.credential:
+        return BlobServiceClient(account_url=cfg.account_url, credential=cfg.credential)
+    return BlobServiceClient(account_url=cfg.account_url)
+
+
+def get_container_name(container_name: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    if container_name:
+        return container_name
+    cfg = load_storage_config()
+    if not cfg.container_name:
+        raise ValueError("AZURE_STORAGE_CONTAINER_NAME is required")
+    return cfg.container_name
+
+
+def normalize_bytes(data: Any) -> bytes:
+    if data is None:
+        return b""
+    if isinstance(data, bytes):
+        return data
+    if isinstance(data, bytearray):
+        return bytes(data)
+    if isinstance(data, str):
+        return data.encode("utf-8")
+    if hasattr(data, "read"):
+        return data.read()
+    raise TypeError("Unsupported upload payload")
+
+
+def to_dict(metadata: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if metadata is None:
+        return {}
+    if isinstance(metadata, dict):
+        return metadata
+    if hasattr(metadata, "items"):
+        return dict(metadata.items())
+    return {k: getattr(metadata, k) for k in dir(metadata) if not k.startswith("_")}
*** End Patch

+from azure.storage.blob import ContentSettings
+
+from storage_client import get_blob_service_client, get_container_name, normalize_bytes
+from storage_models import UploadRequest
+
+
+def upload_object(request: UploadRequest):
+    client = get_blob_service_client()
+    container_name = get_container_name(request.container_name)
+    blob_client = client.get_blob_client(container=container_name, blob=request.object_name)
+    payload = normalize_bytes(request.content)
+    kwargs = {}
+    if request.content_type:
+        kwargs["content_settings"] = ContentSettings(content_type=request.content_type)
+    if request.metadata:
+        kwargs["metadata"] = request.metadata
+    return blob_client.upload_blob(payload, overwrite=True, **kwargs)

+from azure.ai.formrecognizer import DocumentAnalysisClient
+from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential
+
+from storage_client import get_blob_service_client, get_container_name, load_storage_config
+from storage_models import OCRResult
+
+
+def stored_document_ocr(container_name: str, object_name: str) -> OCRResult:
+    cfg = load_storage_config()
+    blob = get_blob_service_client().get_blob_client(get_container_name(container_name), object_name)
+    analyzer = DocumentAnalysisClient(endpoint=cfg.account_url, credential=AzureKeyCredential(cfg.credential or ""))
+    url = blob.url
+    result = analyzer.begin_analyze_document_from_url("prebuilt-read", url).result()
+    text = "\n".join([line.content for page in result.pages for line in page.lines])
+    return OCRResult(text=text, raw={"model_id": "prebuilt-read"})
*** End Patch
